Risk Description: Double booking of the same seat when requests arrive at the same time
Mitigation Strategy: Make the seat hold one atomic database operation (transaction or row lock) and run concurrency tests

Risk Description: Frequent requirement changes (coupons, cancellation rules, new payment modes)
Mitigation Strategy: Formal change control: every change is logged, estimated and approved before work starts; freeze requirements during a sprint

Risk Description: Payment gateway outage or failed callback (money deducted but no ticket issued)
Mitigation Strategy: Use an established PCI-compliant gateway with an SLA so payment processing and card-data liability sit with the provider; add retries and a daily reconciliation job

Risk Description: Security vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, weak login or exposed customer data
Mitigation Strategy: Parameterised queries, password hashing, HTTPS, role-based access, security code review and testing before release; never store card data

Risk Description: Loss of source code or project documents
Mitigation Strategy: Keep all artifacts in Git with a remote repository on GitHub or GitLab; protect the main branch; commit daily
